business_scope.primary_industry_name: Foreign Market Feasibility Study and Regulatory Licensing Agency

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (unitary national civil-law jurisdiction; company registration administered territorially by local Chambers of Commerce)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic codified tradition, including the Código de Comercio of 1971 and Ley 1258 de 2008 for the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Colombia Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 15 May 2012)
Canada-Colombia Free Trade Agreement (in force 15 August 2011)
EU-Colombia-Peru-Ecuador Trade Agreement (provisionally applied 2012; in force for Colombia 1 August 2013)
Colombia-United Kingdom Double Taxation Agreement (in force 2018)
Colombia-Republic of Korea Double Taxation Agreement (in force 2015)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime, Article 5); Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Articles 110 and 116; Ley 526 de 1999 (creates the Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero - UIAF); Ley 1121 de 2006 (national AML/CFT obligations, suspicious transaction reporting); Decreto 1674 de 2016 (UIAF regulatory framework); Ley 1621 de 2013 (financial intelligence); DIAN Resolution 164 de 2020, as amended (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB, mandatory national UBO register administered by the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales); Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia Circular Básica Jurídica (Part S - SARLAFT/UST standards applied by analogy to unregulated obligors)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign incorporation certificate and certificate of good standing of the corporate shareholder (where the S.A.S. has a body-corporate founder)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Origin-country trade registry or competent corporate authority of the shareholder's state of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the origin-country competent authority (Colombia acceded to the Hague Apostille Convention via Ley 455 de 1998, in force domestically from 14 January 2001); where the origin state is not a Convention party, full Colombian consular legalization with chain authentication of the origin Ministry of Foreign Affairs signature

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney granted by the foreign incorporator and each ultimate beneficial owner to the Colombian incorporation attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the origin country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, followed by certified Spanish translation by a recognized Colombian court-certified translator where the original is not in Spanish

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the ultimate beneficial owner's passport and proof of residential address
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Origin-country passport authority and local Colombian notary (certification of copy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization required where the accepting Chamber of Commerce demands it; otherwise notarized in Colombia and accompanied by certified Spanish translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all incorporators, shareholders, legal representatives, and ultimate beneficial owners against the OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and Colombia's national advisory lists issued by UIAF and the Consejo de Seguridad Nacional. Mandatory PEP screening applying the Colombian definition of politically exposed persons under Decreto 1674 de 2016 and Ley 1121 de 2006, aligned with FATF and Wolfsberg standards, with enhanced due diligence where PEP status, adverse media, or jurisdiction-risk flags are identified. Documented identity verification and source-of-funds analysis must be retained no less than five years (ten years where the professional advisor operates as a regulated financial-sector obligor). Any confirmed match or suspicious transaction triggers a suspicious transaction report to UIAF and escalation to the Colombian Fiscalía General de la Nación where required.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial (RUES), administered through the territorial Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the proposed registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá), using the national exact-name and homonym consultation service (consulta de homónimos)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be expressed in Spanish or, where distinctive, in universally accepted Latin-script foreign words; Colombia uses Latin script, so no transliteration into a local alphabet is required. The legal form descriptor 'S.A.S.' must appear at the end of the name. Purely descriptive terms must be rendered in Spanish, and the name must not create identity or similarity confusion with an existing registered entity under Código de Comercio Article 116 and Chamber of Commerce operational rules.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco, Banca, Financiera, Financiero, Ahorro, Seguros, Aseguradora, Pensiones, Fondo, Comisionista de Bolsa, Intermediario Financiero (require prior authorization from Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia)
Cooperativa, Precooperativa, Fondo de Empleados, Asociación Mutual (require prior authorization from Superintendencia de Economía Solidaria)

Presidencia, Ministerio, Gobernación, Alcaldía, Policía, Público, Oficial, Territorial, República, Nacional, Colombia (terms implying official, governmental, or national character require prior authorization from the Ministerio del Interior or Cancillería de Colombia)
IPS, EPS, ARS, Salud, Clínica, Hospital (health-sector terms require authorization from the Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social)
Mining, Hidrocarburos, Telecomunicaciones, Aviación, Aéreo (sector-specific terms triggering prior licensing authority clearance)
S.A., Ltda., Limitada, Asociación, or any corporate descriptor inconsistent with the S.A.S. legal form (misleading form-of-company references)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the incorporator may (i) obtain a fresh homonym certificate with an alternative name variant; (ii) within ten business days file a written reconsideration request (derecho de petición) to the administering Cámara de Comercio under Ley 1437 de 2011 (Código de Procedimiento Administrativo y de lo Contencioso Administrativo), requesting revision of the rejection decision; (iii) if the Chamber upholds the rejection, elevate the matter to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio for administrative supervision, and ultimately pursue judicial review before the administrative contentious courts (jurisdicción contencioso-administrativa). The 30-day reservation window does not toll during appeal; a parallel second reservation with a modified name is strongly recommended to avoid delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally acceptable for ISIC 7020 low-risk consulting: a commercial virtual-office arrangement may satisfy the S.A.S. domicile requirement only where it supplies a verifiable physical Colombian address that accepts service of process, maintains business records, and permits on-site verification by authorities. Purely postal or non-verifiable virtual addresses are rejected by Cámaras de Comercio and create DIAN 'effective establishment' risk; a registered office in the same territorial Chamber jurisdiction is mandatory, and the constitutional document must state the city and address of the domicile (Código de Comercio Article 110(3)).
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate to low-moderate, estimated at 10-15% for a low-risk consultancy in the first 12 months of operation; the Cámara de Comercio conducts unannounced domicile verification visits and DIAN may verify effective establishment and operational substance. The probability materially increases where a virtual office is the sole registered address or where the declared business purpose (market-entry consultancy and licensing agency) implies active local premises.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name clearance certificate (Certificado de homónimos) via RUES at the territorial Chamber of Commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction (RUES network)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory chamber tariff published under Decreto 1074 de 2015 and the annual chamber fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of S.A.S. constitutional document (documento privado de constitución) in Spanish, including by-laws, share structure, and commercial purpose clauses, with senior counsel review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard S.A.S. formation documentation (flat professional fee)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Chamber of Commerce registration: matrícula mercantil, incorporation registration, and registration of corporate books
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction (tarifa de registro)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff banded on initial subscribed capital; approximately COP 543,000 (approx. USD 145) for a low-capital S.A.S.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular legalization of foreign incorporation, power-of-attorney, and UBO identity documents, including notarial authentications and certified Spanish translation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (apostille service) and Colombian consulate in the origin state; local notary for copy certifications
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory per-document apostille fee (approx. COP 40,000-250,000) and notarial certification tariffs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO/RUB pre-filing analysis: beneficial ownership piercing, control mapping, and preparation of the DIAN Resolution 164 de 2020 Beneficiario Final filing structure
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark hourly professional fee for AML/UBO advisory work

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-banking and payments-rail due diligence support: review of Wise B2B and Bank Wire onboarding requirements, correspondent-bank documentation packet, and AML questionnaire preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark professional fee for fintech/correspondent banking documentation review

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: NIT/RUT pre-incorporation consultation and coordination with DIAN for subsequent tax registration (Número de Identificación Tributaria and Registro Único Tributario)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Colombian law firm (DIAN coordination; DIAN itself charges no fee for obtaining the NIT/RUT)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark professional fee for tax registration advisory

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Special Simplified Stock Corporation Regime), Arts. 4-5, 9, 17 and 19; Código de Comercio, Decreto 410 de 1971, Art. 110; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015 (RUES single-window regulation)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) in coordination with the RUES single window and DIAN
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private constitution deed) registered with the Cámara de Comercio; a public deed (escritura pública) is required only when real property is contributed
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum capital is required for a S.A.S. (Ley 1258 de 2008, Art. 4). Shareholders freely fix the subscribed and paid capital; deferred payment of cash subscriptions may extend up to 24 months, while in-kind contributions must be fully paid at execution. An escrow account is not statutorily mandated for standard incorporation, but cash subscriptions should be evidenced by a temporary bank deposit certificate attached to the constitution document.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: FIRST, the share subscription and initial capital payment plan in the incorporation document are ratified by the sole shareholder. SECOND, the registered office in Bogotá D.C., Colombia is adopted as the statutory domicile for all legal, tax and administrative purposes. THIRD, [Name], holder of citizen ID No. [ID], is appointed sole legal representative and general manager with the full powers of Ley 1258 of 2008. FOURTH, [Name] is appointed alternate legal representative. FIFTH, the legal representative is authorized to obtain the RUT and NIT from DIAN, open corporate bank accounts, and complete registrations before the Cámara de Comercio. SIXTH, the secretary shall certify and archive this resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Check and Reservation (Certificado de Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) - RUES virtual portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name-search application via the Chamber's online virtual office (casillero virtual), indicating up to three proposed corporate names. Pay the nominal search fee. The Chamber issues a Certificado de Homonimia confirming that no identical or confusingly similar name is registered and reserves the chosen name for 30 calendar days on the RUES.
required_dossiers: Copy of the shareholder's identity document
Payment receipt of the search fee
Proposed company name with up to three alternatives
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the preferred name is rejected for similarity, file a new homonymy application listing alternative names; the Chamber's review is conclusive and refiling is completed within one additional business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Private Incorporation Document (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Sole shareholder or parties; Notaría (Notary Public) only if real property is contributed
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the constitution document under Ley 1258 of 2008, including the corporate purpose (ISIC 7020 overseas market-entry consultancy), share classes and capital, payment terms, registered office, officer appointments, and an optional arbitration clause. Execute the document by the shareholder(s); notarization of signatures is optional unless real estate assets are contributed. Cash subscriptions are paid into a temporary bank account and evidenced by a deposit certificate attached to the document.
required_dossiers: RUT copies of shareholders (if individually registered)
Bank deposit certificate for subscribed cash capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber queries a clause, amend the document by a private clarification act (acta de aclaración) and refile within the five-business-day correction window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Merchant Registry Enrollment and RUES Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (registration office and RUES single window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed original constitution document, the RUES registration forms and the legal representative's acceptance to the Chamber's registry. Pay the registration fee (derechos de inscripción) and the municipal registration tax. After review, the Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal and enrolls the company in the RUES with the matrícula mercantil included.
required_dossiers: Original signed private constitution document (two copies)
Formulario Único de Registro Empresarial (RUES form)
Payment receipt of registration fee and registration tax
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues an 'auto de devolución' citing formal defects, correct the document and resubmit within the granted curative term (typically five business days); the payment is retained and applied to the finalized registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration with DIAN and NIT Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) - online portal 'muisca'
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into DIAN's electronic service using the pre-registration number obtained from the Chamber, complete the RUT details, and select the applicable tax responsibilities (corporate income tax, VAT if applicable, and withholding agent status where thresholds are met). Upon approval, the NIT is assigned and the RUT certificate becomes available for download.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation from the Chamber
Copy of the legal representative's identity document
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT is suspended or rejected for data inconsistency, file a correction request (solicitud de corrección de datos RUT) in the muisca portal; the adjustment is resolved within two business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Registration with Banco de la República (Non-Resident Shareholders)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Banco de la República - Subgerencia de Inversiones Internacionales (electronic registration through a commercial bank or directly)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If any shareholder is non-resident, register the capital contribution as foreign direct investment by submitting the exchange declaration form and the Chamber registration certificate. Attach evidence of the bank wire transfer (if any). This registration is a prerequisite for future dividend remittance and capital repatriation under Colombia's foreign exchange regime.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation
Bank wire confirmation and exchange declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late registration is permitted: file an 'inscripción extemporánea' with supporting transfer documentation; no penalty is imposed on the underlying investment registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Formation Governance and Operating Formalities (ARL, Municipal Taxes, Bank Account)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL), municipal treasury (ICA), and chosen financial institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Enroll the legal representative and any initial employees in social security (EPS/ARP) and affiliate the company with an ARL classified as risk level I for office services. Register the company with the municipal industry-and-commerce tax (ICA) through the district finance secretariat. Open corporate bank accounts presenting the Chamber, DIAN and RUT certificates.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ARL assigns an incorrect risk rating, request reclassification by submitting job descriptions and the office lease; municipal ICA registration can be rectified by filing a corrected municipal form.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial license is mandated for ISIC 7020 consulting activities; oversight reference: Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo (MINCIT) and Superintendencia de Sociedades (corporate supervision)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) enrollment and municipal industry-and-commerce tax (ICA) registration; optional certificado de actividad económica for international consultancy

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) / municipal environmental authority (autoridad ambiental urbana)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no EIA screening required for office-based management consultancy (ISIC 7020); only municipal harmless-activity registration applies
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC discharge; office operations must comply with Decree 1076 of 2015 (domestic wastewater), Law 1259 of 2008 (solid waste), and Resolution 2254 of 2017 (ambient air quality; negligible emissions for consultancy)

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (Certificado de Bomberos) from the municipal Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos, use-of-soil and structural load clearance from the local planning office (Curaduría Urbana / Alcaldía), and workplace safety registration with the ARL and Ministerio de Trabajo compliance for office premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (National Tax and Customs Directorate); official transactional portal: Muisca (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado) at https://www.dian.gov.co.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-owned S.A.S. registration sequence: (1) incorporator executes private deed and registers the company with the Cámara de Comercio of its domicile, obtaining the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal and mercantile pre-registration data; (2) within 30 days the legal representative, holding a Colombian digital certificate, activates the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) in Muisca, which automatically assigns the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria); (3) the RUT must be updated to reflect statutory tax roles: 'Responsable de IVA – Régimen Común', 'Declarante de Renta', and 'Exportador de Servicios' (calidad de exportador); (4) complete electronic invoicing 'habilitación' by registering internal billing software or engaging an authorized technology operator to obtain the CUFE validation scheme; (5) non-resident shareholders require their own NIT only for dividend withholding and transfer-pricing compliance, obtainable by appointing a Colombian apoderado who files the RUT pre-registration with the shareholder's passport data.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation – The S.A.S. is a resident juridical person taxed as a separate taxpayer on worldwide net income under the Estatuto Tributario. Territorial scope: Colombian-source income plus foreign-source income attributable to a Colombian permanent establishment; the corporate income tax (Impuesto sobre la Renta) is 35% for 2025, with no pass-through option. Dividend distributions to non-resident shareholders are subject to a final 10% withholding at the distribution date, applying the imputation/credit mechanism that avoids double taxation on already-taxed profits. Municipal ICA (Impuesto de Industria y Comercio) applies at 0.2%–1.4% on gross consulting fees depending on city.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style 'check-the-box' or voluntary hybrid-mismatch elections exist; Colombia applies anti-hybrid and CFC rules automatically under Law 2010/2019 and Law 2277/2022. Available elections relevant to this ISIC 7020 profile: (i) Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) – elective integrated income/VAT regime for entities with prior-year gross ordinary revenue not exceeding 3,500 UVT (approx. COP 174,296,500 for 2025); consulting services are taxed at progressive rates of approximately 2.2%–14.5% on gross revenue, replacing the separate 19% VAT and income-tax advance; (ii) Deducción por inversión en activos fijos productivos – allows an extra 30% depreciation-deduction election on qualifying new fixed assets; (iii) bimestral VAT export-refund election under ET Art. 855 for exporters with periodic saldo a favor; (iv) voluntary ICA 'régimen de retención' alternatives available at the municipal level. Tax consolidation is not available to standalone S.A.S. entities; group statements are consolidated only for financial reporting.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA – Impuesto sobre las Ventas (Value-Added Tax) governed by ET Arts. 420 et seq. and administered nationally by DIAN; complementary municipal gross-receipts tax ICA (Industria y Comercio) and national excise taxes apply outside the VAT system.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No economic or turnover threshold exists for commercial companies: an S.A.S. providing taxable consultancy services is objectively required to register as a VAT responsible (Régimen Común) from the first taxable transaction (ET Art. 437). The only quantitative exclusion applies to natural persons without a commercial establishment whose annual gross income does not exceed 3,500 UVT (COP 174,296,500 for the 2025 UVT of COP 49,799) and who do not import taxable goods; these persons remain 'no responsables de IVA'. The CO_SAS entity must therefore register in the RUT and obtain prior authorization for electronic invoicing regardless of revenue level.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory end-to-end electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta – FEV): all taxable services must be issued and transmitted in real time to DIAN through Muisca, either via the DIAN-authorized web service (FIT) or through an authorized technology operator. Each FEV must contain the statutory CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) or the CUDS code for support documents, plus a QR, and must be validated by DIAN before it becomes fiscally operative; invoices that fail validation are legally ineffective. The taxpayer's billing software must be previously 'habilitado' by DIAN and all purchase vouchers from non-invoicing suppliers must be reported through the Documento Soporte en Adquisiciones a No Obligados a Facturar. As of 2025, DIAN has fully fiscalized the real-time clearance cycle, including 100% inspection of XML payloads, UUID conformity, and cross-referencing with customs and FX data.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A foreign market-entry consultancy service (ISIC 7020) qualifies for the 0% VAT export rate under ET Art. 481 and Decree 1893/2019 only if the following cumulative tests are satisfied and documented: (i) the client is a non-resident entity with no permanent establishment or branch in Colombia; (ii) the consultancy is developed and its economic benefit is realized exclusively outside Colombian territory, including overseas delivery of feasibility reports, regulatory gap analyses, market-entry strategies, and remote or offshore advisory sessions; (iii) the consideration is effectively paid from abroad by a non-resident payer through a foreign-currency remittance, external bank account, or an approved B2B cross-border rail such as Wise B2B, and is not charged to a Colombian domicile; and (iv) the S.A.S. holds the 'calidad de exportador' marker in its RUT and reports the operation as an export of services in Muisca, including issuance of an FEV with the foreign client's TIN and CUFE. Services that generate benefits within Colombia, such as local regulatory lobbying, domestic branch assistance, or negotiating with Colombian government authorities, are taxable at 19%. Qualified exporters may file bimestral VAT returns and request refund of the resulting saldo a favor, with the right to accelerated refund where the exporter has maintained an impeccable compliance record.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration – for services: the DIAN export-of-services declaration (Form 504 / Muisca export module) identifying the ISIC 7020 transaction, the foreign client, and the legal basis for the 0% rate; for any physical deliverables (e.g., printed feasibility kits or market-study prototypes) a DEX (Declaración de Exportación) must be concurrently filed through the VUCE system.

Bill of Lading – required where physical goods accompany the consultancy (airway bill or ocean bill of lading evidencing goods leaving Colombian customs territory); for purely offshore services, the functional equivalent is the signed technical-services contract, the FEV with CUFE, and the delivery acceptance certificate from the foreign client.

Inward Remittance Certificate – certificado de canalización de divisas issued by a local market-intermediary bank (or Banco de la República Form 520/530) demonstrating that the Wise B2B or bank-wire proceeds were collected and channeled through the Colombian foreign-exchange market within the statutory term.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may reopen export zero-rating positions for 5 years (10 years where no return was filed) and may retroactively recharacterize the service as taxable at 19% where any of the four zero-rating conditions is missing. Violations trigger: (i) full VAT assessment plus monthly moratory interest (currently around 1.5% per month, compounded); (ii) inaccuracy penalty up to 200% of the omitted tax (ET Art. 648); (iii) export-commodity misdeclaration penalties under customs law; (iv) clawback of any VAT refund obtained without entitlement, increased by 100% under ET Art. 668 plus interest; (v) criminal liability for fraudulent export invoicing or false quality-of-exporter declarations under Law 1762/2015, with imprisonment of 48 to 144 months for aggravated contraband; and (vi) administrative consequences including cancellation of the 'calidad de exportador', exclusion from the accelerated refund procedure, and mandatory electronic-invoicing audit for subsequent periods.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia / BCREP), acting as the foreign-exchange authority under the Estatuto Cambiario (Decree 1735 of 1993), with direct implementing rules in Resolución Externa No. 1 of 2018 (as amended) and the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) supervising FX compliance of authorized intermediaries.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente/Ahorros) in COP and USD; inward FDI proceeds received in COP with conversion
Operational Account and foreign-currency (USD) current account; capital contribution window

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of Commercial Registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil) of the S.A.S. in the national business registry (RUES)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Chamber of Commerce of the registered domicile (Cámara de Comercio, e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually no later than 31 March, filed electronically through the Chamber of Commerce portal (RUES)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late-renewal surcharge equal to 10% of the renewal tariff for each month or fraction of month of delay; failure to renew for three consecutive years triggers cancellation of the commercial registration and strike-off of the entity from the commercial registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval and registration of the annual financial statements (Estados Financieros de Fin de Ejercicio) evidenced by the shareholders' meeting minutes (Acta de Asamblea)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Chamber of Commerce (attached to the annual renewal file)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' meeting must be held and statements approved by 31 March following the 31 December cut-off; filing accompanies the annual renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to approve and file statements blocks the renewal procedure; financial statements not filed are inadmissible as evidence against third parties and may trigger liability of the legal representative for damages.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios) for the preceding fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Unidad Administrativa Especial Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within the staggered calendar set by DIAN Resolution according to the last two NIT digits, generally mid-August through late-September of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine of 5% per month or fraction of month on the tax payable, capped at 100% of the tax, with a floor of 10 UVT; default interest at 1.5 times the current bank lending rate (E.T. Arts. 634 and 641); failure blocks issuance of fiscal compliance certificates and the renewal of the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation and update of the Beneficial Owner Registry (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually aligned with the NIT-digit income-tax return calendar; any change in direct or indirect shareholding or controlling rights must be reported within one month of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Imposition of fines of up to 20,000 UVT for non-reporting, late reporting, or misrepresentation (E.T. Art. 658-4); an outstanding RUB position withholds issuance of RUES certificates and complicates bank and regulatory procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual exogenous (payee-level) information return (Información Exógena Tributaria) where statutory thresholds are met (e.g., annual payments to a single party above approximately 90 million COP or more than ten employees)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within the February-April window fixed by the applicable DIAN Resolution for the preceding tax year, staggered by NIT digit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Sanctions under E.T. Art. 651, including fines of 3%-5% of the amounts not reported, subject to UVT limits and a floor of 10 UVT; late filing in respect of withholding obligations may be treated cumulatively.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual municipal industry and commerce tax return (Impuesto de Industria y Comercio - ICA) and the complementary avisos declaration where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipal treasury of the taxing municipality (in the S.A.S. domicile, e.g., Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 30 April following the tax year for the annual scheme; bimonthly declarations apply where gross billings exceed the municipal threshold of approximately 27,000 UVT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment arrears interest plus municipal late-filing surcharges of 5% per month on the ICA payable (minimum 5 UVT); persistent non-compliance enables municipal enforcement and negative tax-conduct certifications.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (general resident-company rate; S.A.S. is a resident legal entity taxed under Article 240 of the Estatuto Tributario)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday for ISIC 7020 consultancy. Available preferential deductions: 100% deduction for certified investments in scientific research/technological innovation (annual cap 25% of taxable income), accelerated depreciation in eligible green-asset investments, and deductions for new formal employment in certain regions. These do not create an exempt period and the effective rate remains 35% absent specific approved incentives.
